simple.meaning: שַׁלְהֶבֶת (shalhebeth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a flare of fire.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Job, Song of Solomon, Ezekiel, beginning at Job 15:30. Its contexts include righteousness, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שַׁלְהֶבֶת (H7957).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שַׁלְהֶבֶת (shalhebeth) / H7957 is traced through Job 15:30, Song of Songs 8:6, Ezekiel 21:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H7957. shalhebeth שַׁלְהֶ֫בֶת noun feminine flame (Aramaic שַׁלְהוֺבִיתָא ) — in שׁ ׳לַהֶבֶת Ezek 21:3 , of judgment; so שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת Job 15:30 ; שַׁלְהֶבֶתְיָה אֵשׁ רִשְׁמֵּי Song 8:6 i.e. Yahweh-flame = powerful flame (> Jäger BAS i.471 Jastr JBL xiii (1894), 111 explains יָֿה here as encl. particle)
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 3851 with sibilant prefix;

occurrences.englishText: He will not depart out of darkness.
